eyebrow: Git & GitHub for Software Engineers · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 8 · GitHub Essentials

code:
git push origin main

# first push of a new branch:
git push -u origin main

# after that, just:
git push
caption: Uploads local commits the remote doesn't have yet. -u links future pushes automatically.

code:
git fetch origin

# inspect before deciding:
git log origin/main
caption: Updates your record of the remote's branches — your working files are untouched.

eyebrow: git pull: fetch + merge in one step
code:
git pull origin main

# equivalent to:
git fetch origin
git merge origin/main
caption: Convenient for routine work — but merges automatically, which can surprise you.
